info.title: BanglaPSG Complaints API
info.description: Anonymous complaint submission and preview; JWT-protected administration. Run migrations before startup. Complaint/group reviews require expected_version and reason; privacy deletion previews before explicit application.

post.description: Exchange configured admin credentials for a short-lived bearer JWT.
Preview analysis without writing complaints, reviews or audit records.
Persist a report and propose membership only after area/time guards.

get.description: Filter and paginate reports. Reads require JWT unless redacted reads are enabled.

patch.description: Confirm/override current fields; preserve immutable automatic analysis as feedback provenance.

get.description:
Return minimal status for a random tracking ID; never disclose report/contact content.

The ID is a capability: keep it private. There is deliberately no public
tracking directory/search. Anonymous users cannot retrieve full reports.

post.description: Confirm membership, optionally moving explicitly reviewed complaint IDs into this group.
Move a proper subset to a separate reviewed partition; automation cannot undo it.

get.description: Aggregate counts only; never expose complaint wording or admin credentials.

post.description:
Preview by default. Explicit apply deletes selected reports and sanitizes linked copies.

Backups, exported files, other worker memory and separately trained models
require the operator's maintenance runbook; this is not machine unlearning.

get.description:
Administrator chart aggregates across all rows, independent of queue pagination.

Daily counts describe current priorities by report creation date. They
are not a history of past model decisions or resolution times.
Readiness is degraded in development when trained artifacts are absent.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Minimum calibrated category/severity top probability; not a calibrated joint, priority or duplicate probability.

duplicate_candidates.title: Duplicate Candidates
duplicate_candidates.description: Redacted score/guard suggestions. Other citizens' record IDs and metadata are omitted.

AnalysisResponse.title: AnalysisResponse
AnalysisResponse.description: Core triage contract with additional research/provenance fields preserved.

version.title: Version
version.description: Use as expected_version in an admin PATCH.

group_version.title: Group Version
group_version.description: Current group version, if the complaint belongs to a group.

location.title: Location
location.description: Submitted location; omitted from optional public reads.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Optional private contact. Only authenticated administrator reads include this field.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Calibrated classification confidence, not priority or duplicate confidence.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: Automatic analysis snapshot. Citizen receipts redact other reports' identifiers and metadata.

ComplaintView.title: ComplaintView
ComplaintView.description: Submission receipt or admin record; optional fields require read access.

version.title: Version
version.description: Use as expected_version for confirm or split.

confirmed_by.title: Confirmed By
confirmed_by.description: Admin identity; omitted from optional public reads.

complaint_ids.title: Complaint Ids
complaint_ids.description: Up to 1,000 sorted member IDs; omitted from optional public reads.

members_truncated.title: Members Truncated
members_truncated.description: True when the member-ID list is capped at 1,000.

TrackingResponse.title: TrackingResponse
TrackingResponse.description: Possession of the random tracking ID permits only this minimal summary.
